title: Terminal access verified
summary: The direct terminal route responds locally and real PowerShell, Python and Node.js sessions passed their regression checks.

changes.detail: Direct Terminal navigation with PowerShell selected; close returns to the previous page or More, and Explain opens the teacher.

validation.name: Runtime tests
validation.detail: 4 terminal tests passed: PowerShell state/directory, Python input/Ctrl+C, Node state, runtime discovery. Kali skipped because not installed; node-pty cleanup emitted AttachConsole diagnostics.

validation.name: TypeScript and lint
validation.detail: Direct local tsc --noEmit and ESLint on both changed files completed without errors. Used local binaries after npm/npx wrapper stalled.

validation.name: History tests
validation.detail: All 4 history tests passed; append-only history check passed before final report.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Signed-in browser interaction and native phone not tested. Interactive terminal available on web with local PC server. No deployment.
